title: Figure 9. Atlas IIAS Simulation Results with B = 1,000
description: Semi-log line graph titled in-plot "Atlas IIAS Random-Attitude Failures through 280 sec," plotting "Percent in 5-deg sector (%)" against "Angle From Flight Path (deg)" (0 to 180). Marked curves show simulated impacts for no breakup and breakup q-alphas of 20,000, 10,000 and 5,000 deg-lb/ft^2, compared with theoretical Mode-5 curves for B = 1,000 and A = 1.90, 2.75, 3.20 and 3.45. Text notes that no single value of A matches the simulated distribution across all sectors.
